code.note: The last commit that touched the code this file is computed by. Rerunning the builder with that code and the census above writes this file byte for byte.

scope.line: Every Aave V3 pool in the registry and every Morpho Blue market, on Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism and Base
scope.inScope: Every Aave V3 pool registered in the PoolAddressesProviderRegistry of mainnet, Arbitrum, Optimism and Base, and the Morpho Blue singleton of each of those chains (recall-coverage/inputs/oct10/onchain/events-scan.json).
scope.outOfScope: Every other chain (Avalanche alone had 531 Aave V3 liquidations in the window), Aave V2, Spark and the other Aave forks.

meta.oracle: Every position’s line and its minute-by-minute LTV walk use its own protocol’s oracle, read on chain: each Aave V3 market’s AaveOracle and each Morpho Blue market’s own oracle, the price in force at each minute start (no look-ahead). Dollars: an Aave liquidation is valued at the liquidating block’s AaveOracle prices. A Morpho position is walked in its loan token; its dollars are the loan token at $1 for a dollar stablecoin, else that token’s Aave oracle price on the same chain at the minute start (EURC, LBTC, WETH, cbBTC), and a loan token with neither is left out of every dollar figure.

exclusions.rule: A position is compared only when Membrane can walk it: (1) at least one collateral leg has a Membrane line (otherwise "no-membrane-line": nothing is invented for AAVE, tETH, LBTC, …), and (2) every collateral token it would have to sell had observed liquidity on its chain (otherwise "no-capacity"). Excluded positions are left out of BOTH sides of every total; their real side stays in the rows.

partialLine.rule: Compared, but some collateral legs have no Membrane line: those legs are left out of the value-weighted line (the per-wallet simulator's rule, weightedMembraneLine) and still count as collateral. The strict alternative — exclude these too — is the sensitivity strictLines (scripts/build-evidence-census.ts).

line.rule: MEMBRANE'S OWN LINE (owner ruling 2026-10-18; lib/wavefront/membraneLine.ts): the per-wallet simulator's rule — weightedMembraneLine of the t0 collateral (MEMBRANE_ASSET_LTV, modelled: WETH 0.80, wstETH 0.78, WBTC 0.75, …; DEPLOY_LAUNCH_LTV, the deploy script's own: sUSDS 0.88, syrupUSDC 0.86, scrvUSD 0.86), value-weighted at t0, each asset clamped to its class cap. Legs with no Membrane line are left out of the weighted line; a position with no leg that has one is excluded ('no-membrane-line'). The protocol's line (Aave weighted LT, Morpho LLTV) stays in each row as `line`: it locates t0 and is the published sensitivity 'Membrane at the protocol's line'. The position still enters at the protocol's liquidation (t0); on a lower line it is further past its line there.
line.source: lib/position-sim/membrane.ts MEMBRANE_ASSET_LTV (modelled) and DEPLOY_LAUNCH_LTV (script/DeployFullSystem.s.sol:243-251), through lib/wavefront/membraneLine.ts — the per-wallet simulator’s own rule.

liquidity.rule: Every Membrane collateral sale draws on one shared book per (chain, token): at most 1.1 x capacity tokens in any rolling 10 minutes, where CAPACITY is the most tokens that left liquidated borrowers in any rolling 10 minutes of 10-11 Oct on that chain, over every Aave V3 and Morpho Blue liquidation of the census (Aave: liquidatedCollateralAmount + the protocol fee; Morpho: seized assets). Capacity is a rate, available at any minute. Sales draw in order minute, then pid. A sale's unfilled part stays pending and sells at later minutes at those minutes' prices, never past the borrow cap (lib/wavefront/kernel.ts PENDING ORDERS). Debt repayment is not limited; only collateral sales are.
liquidity.multiplierBasis: MODELLED (†): the 8-hour delay lets some of the market liquidity recover. 0.5x, 1.0x, 2.0x and unlimited are published beside it.

sensitivities.rule: Membrane's sales of a token on a chain share 2x the most tokens liquidators absorbed in any rolling 10 minutes of the window.

sensitivities.label: unlimited (the old assumption)
sensitivities.rule: Every sale fills at once at the oracle price, in any size: the assumption before 2026-10-18. Same positions as the headline.

sensitivities.label: Membrane at the protocol's own line, 1.1x capacity
sensitivities.rule: Each position walked at its protocol's line (Aave weighted LT, Morpho LLTV) instead of Membrane's; positions with no Membrane line are back in. Its own compared set.

sensitivities.label: Membrane at the protocol's own line, unlimited
sensitivities.rule: The census before 2026-10-18 (its 157.06M), less the positions that would have to sell a token with no observed liquidity.

sensitivities.label: Strict lines, 1.1x capacity
sensitivities.rule: A position with ANY collateral leg that has no Membrane line is excluded too (the headline leaves those legs out of the weighted line).

sensitivities.label: band 2%
sensitivities.rule: The delay band at 2% instead of 4%.

sensitivities.label: band 8%
sensitivities.rule: The delay band at 8% instead of 4%.

sensitivities.label: nobody clears the timer early
sensitivities.rule: A return under the line does not stop the timer.

sensitivities.label: no $2,000 floor
sensitivities.rule: Every sale is the bare repay to cap.

sensitivities.label: one sale per position
sensitivities.rule: The walk stops after the first sale (its pending remainder still fills).

sensitivities.label: stop after a sale at t0
sensitivities.rule: The headline walks a delayed position sold at t0 past line x (1 + band) on after that sale, like every other sale: a sale leaves no timer (a band break or an expiry deletes it, LiquidationEngine.sol:1724-1727 at 16e12329; an Immediate sale, :1694-1703, never had one) and nothing closes the position. This rebuild stops it after the one t0 repay — the behaviour before 2026-10-14.

sensitivities.label: t0 at block N-1 prices
sensitivities.rule: t0 is valued at block-N oracle prices, or at block N-1 where N does not show the breach the protocol liquidated. For positions the protocol's own check locates at BOTH bases, this counts those whose t0 decision (per half: under the line / inside the band / past the band / no-delay sale) differs between the two, and rebuilds the census valuing every position at N-1 wherever N-1 locates it.

meta.method: Every position liquidated on an Aave V3 pool or a Morpho Blue market of Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism or Base between 00:00 UTC 10 Oct and 23:59 UTC 11 Oct 2025: 3,197 positions, of which 2,280 are compared. Only DEBT REPAID is compared: Membrane’s liquidation fee cannot be assumed, so collateral taken is not. The real side is every liquidation of the position in that window, measured on chain: the debt the liquidators repaid (Aave: at the liquidating block’s AaveOracle prices; Morpho: in the loan token, priced as below). Membrane’s side starts from the same position at the first liquidation the protocol’s own health check confirms (t0), with its whole composition read the block before, and walks it minute by minute on each leg’s own protocol-oracle path, at MEMBRANE’S OWN LINE: the value-weighted modelled max LTV of its collateral (WETH 80%, wstETH 78%, WBTC 75%, …)†, lower than most protocol lines, so a position is further past its line at t0. A breach inside line × 1.04 waits eight hours; a return under the line clears the timer; past the band, or still over the line at expiry, the position is repaid to its borrow cap (line − 3pp) with the $2,000 floor, and it walks on. Stablecoin collateral, or a line above 90%, gets no window and is repaid the minute it is over its line†. A position holding both is split the way Membrane would hold it. Every sale is LIQUIDITY-CAPPED†: all of Membrane’s sales of a token on a chain share 1.1× the most tokens liquidators actually absorbed in any 10 minutes of the two days (Aave and Morpho together); what does not fill waits and sells in later minutes at those minutes’ prices, never past the borrow cap. Left out of both sides: 866 positions whose collateral has no Membrane line ($23.34M repaid by the protocols) and 51 that would have to sell a token nobody liquidated on that chain ($662k). Both sides are summed over the same positions; the 7 whose loan token has no USD price count in every position total and in no dollar total.
meta.sameSet: Both sides are reported on the same positions: the COMPARED ones — walked, with a Membrane line, and with liquidity for every token Membrane would sell (meta.exclusions). The stream marks only those `walked` and its reducer folds real records into its totals for them only; any other position counts in coverage and nowhere else. USD totals skip a position whose loan token has no USD price, on both sides.

gridEnd.rule: A position still inside its 8-hour window when the data ends (23:59 UTC 11 Oct) has not been sold: the window is still open. The census books it as sold at the last minute’s price, the conservative choice, and every Membrane total here includes that sale. It is marked wherever it appears.

crossCheck.label: Old census (747 rows, superseded)
crossCheck.line: The old census priced 747 Aave accounts and said Membrane closes 36% less (Aave $34.69M, Membrane $22.20M). On the same 747 rows this census gives $34.70M and $13.13M†. The Membrane side moved because the old census priced every account off mainnet Chainlink rounds: each L2 chain’s own oracle moves it −$8.10M, mainnet’s AaveOracle instead of the round log −$2.93M, the full composition instead of the liquidated leg +$861k, the line −$989, and the factors together another +$1.10M. Switching all four back reproduces the old $22.20M to within $1,698.

caveats: Membrane has no mainnet deployment. Everything on its side is the contract’s rules run against the day’s real prices†, not a measurement of a live protocol.

9 positions were still inside their 8-hour window when the data ends (23:59 UTC 11 Oct). A window still open is not a completed sale; the census books each as sold at the last price, which is the conservative choice. Those sales are $8k of Membrane’s total† and are marked in the table.

7 Morpho positions borrow a token with no USD price on that day (DEGEN, EURCV, eUSD, sUSDS). They are walked and counted in every position total, and left out of every dollar total and median on both sides.
Only debt repaid is compared. Membrane’s liquidation fee is not assumed, so collateral taken from the borrower is not a comparison on either side.
The real side can repay more than the debt at t0: a borrower can borrow again between liquidations, and interest accrues. Membrane’s walk starts from the t0 position and adds neither.

Membrane’s line is modelled†: no Membrane market is deployed, and the per-asset max LTVs (WETH 80%, wstETH 78%, WBTC 75%, …) are our assumption. Most are below the protocols’ own lines, so the same position is further past Membrane’s line at the first liquidation and is repaid further down. 866 positions whose collateral has no Membrane line ($23.34M repaid by the protocols) are left out of both sides; the protocol’s-line run is published beside the headline.

Sales are capped by the liquidity the day actually showed: 1.1× the most tokens liquidators absorbed in any 10 minutes, per token and chain, shared by every Membrane sale. The 1.1× is a modelled assumption† (the delay lets some liquidity recover); 0.5×, 1×, 2× and unlimited are published. Each fill is priced at the oracle, not at a market impact price.
The timer is cleared the minute a position is back under its line. Both clearing paths are permissionless calls somebody has to make; the sensitivity where nobody does is published below.
The cure column is a price-only diagnostic: it ignores the band and re-arming, and no dollar is computed from it.
The result is path-dependent. 10 Oct was a sharp wick with a partial recovery; a market that keeps falling would not cure.
Out of scope: every chain other than Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism and Base, and every lending venue other than Aave V3 and Morpho Blue (Aave V2, Spark and the Aave forks).

all.label: Aave V3 and Morpho Blue, four chains

cure.definition: Price only, the same definition as the old builder (scripts/build-evidence.ts): the position’s LTV at every minute from t0 to t0 + 8h (or the data end), its whole t0 composition with every leg on its own protocol-oracle path, against its own line. Cured = the lowest LTV in that span is at or under the line; minutes = when that lowest LTV is reached; healthy at 8h = the LTV at the last minute is at or under the line. A position with no window (stablecoin collateral, or a line above 90%) is never counted cured. It ignores the band and re-arming: it is a diagnostic, and no dollar is computed from it.

oneRepay.basis: Both sides without the liquidity cap: one repay to cap at t0 against the unlimited walk on the same positions.

freshPrints.source: AaveOracle (Aave V3 Core, mainnet), price in force at each minute start

noEarlyClear.rule: Nobody calls the permissionless clear: a return under the line does not stop the timer, so a delay that started runs to its expiry or its band break (DelayTimer noEarlyClear).

noDebtFloor.rule: The $2,000 liqDebtMinimum floor is not applied: every sale is the bare repay to cap.

singleSale.rule: At most one sale per position: the walk stops after the first repay to cap (headline: up to 20).

noWalkOnAfterT0BandSale.rule: The headline walks a delayed position sold at t0 past line x (1 + band) on after that sale, like every other sale: a sale leaves no timer (a band break or an expiry deletes it, LiquidationEngine.sol:1724-1727 at 16e12329; an Immediate sale, :1694-1703, never had one) and nothing closes the position. This rebuild stops it after the one t0 repay — the behaviour before 2026-10-14.

t0PriceBasis.rule: t0 is valued at block-N oracle prices, or at block N-1 where N does not show the breach the protocol liquidated. For positions the protocol's own check locates at BOTH bases, this counts those whose t0 decision (per half: under the line / inside the band / past the band / no-delay sale) differs between the two, and rebuilds the census valuing every position at N-1 wherever N-1 locates it.
